release_candidate.note: Later commits change only documentation and test harnesses.

decision_reason: No open critical or high finding, but mandatory gates are BLOCKED or NOT VERIFIED: deployment-owned controls (TLS, secrets, database role, branch protection), unapproved exceptions, authenticated DAST and production-size load testing.

gates.name: Repository and attack-surface discovery
gates.summary: All 189 routes inventoried and classified (access, controls, asset); stack, integrations, CI, containers, AI (none) identified

gates.name: Threat model and trust boundaries
gates.summary: Assets, identities, trust boundaries, 11 abuse cases with controls and tests

gates.name: Dependencies and software supply chain
gates.summary: 0 advisories (Composer, npm, OSV); app and web images pass Trivy HIGH/CRITICAL; actions pinned. Blocked only by the unapproved exceptions R-04 (postgres image gosu, not reachable) and R-05 (third-party vendor docs files)

gates.name: Authentication, sessions, account recovery
gates.summary: Brute force, 2FA budget, token reuse, session/remember-token revocation, reset-token lifetime and anti-enumeration timing verified by tests and probes. Open low finding SEC-30 (registration reveals emails) proposed as accepted risk

gates.name: Authorization, privilege escalation, tenant isolation
gates.summary: Every route parameter has a server-side check; cross-user and cross-role tests (PHPUnit, simulation); self-dealing blocked. Row-level security not used: single application role, isolation enforced in code (justified)

gates.name: Input validation and injection
gates.summary: No interpolated SQL, no unescaped HTML output, text-only mails, CSV formula escaping; Semgrep registry and project rules clean; ZAP active scan: no injection

gates.name: CSRF, CORS, browser and transport security
gates.summary: CSRF (419), no CORS headers, CSP/HSTS/XFO/nosniff/COOP verified on the production images. Blocked: the production TLS terminator is deployment-owned and not available

gates.name: File uploads, downloads, path traversal
gates.summary: Generated names, private disks, signed + owned downloads, ClamAV fail-closed, 25 MP decode cap, quotas, throttling, 413 above 55 MB, traversal probes 400/403/404

gates.name: SSRF, external requests, webhooks
gates.summary: No user-controlled outbound URLs; Shkeeper client without redirects; HMAC + timestamp + de-dup verified (401 for unsigned, wrong, stale); callback URL pinned to APP_URL

gates.name: Business logic and financial abuse
gates.summary: Earnings held through the dispute window, claim-before-transfer with per-attempt ids, unknown outcomes pending, refund caps under locks, self-dealing blocked; simulation scenarios incl. concurrency

gates.name: API security, abuse prevention, DoS
gates.summary: Per-route limits verified (cannot be bypassed with forwarded headers), body/header/query limits at nginx. Behaviour under load at production size not verified (4-core sandbox)

gates.name: Secrets, configuration, infrastructure
gates.summary: No secret in 96 commits (gitleaks); .env untracked; containers read-only, no capabilities, unprivileged; debug off. Blocked: secret storage, DB role, network egress and backups are deployment-owned

gates.name: Logging, monitoring, incident readiness
gates.summary: Failed logins (hashed email), 2FA abuse, webhook signature failures, 403/419/429, admin actions (audit log), owner security mails; no secrets in logs (checked on the stack)

gates.name: AI and LLM security
gates.summary: No model, agent, retrieval or prompt in the repository (searched code and dependencies)

gates.name: OWASP Top 10:2025 mapping
gates.summary: All ten categories assessed with evidence; no ASVS level claimed

gates.name: Automated SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC, image testing
gates.summary: All gate scans pass; ZAP baseline and unauthenticated active scan (223 URLs): no failures. Authenticated DAST per role not run

gates.name: Remediation and regression verification
gates.summary: 39 findings: 38 fixed, each with a regression test that failed before the fix (or a probe), 1 open low (SEC-30)

gates.name: Final independent reassessment
gates.summary: Independent review of the fix diff (5 problems found and fixed), images rebuilt from the candidate, gate, probes and full simulation re-run on the candidate

gates.name: CI/CD enforcement
gates.summary: CI job 'security' runs scripts/security-gate.sh and fails on any failing or unrunnable check; CODEOWNERS added. Blocked: branch protection and required checks need a repository admin
